capital_event.recognition: conditional forecast assumes all cash/equity at year end, split and regulatory eligibility unverified; never booked in reported history
capital_event.sensitivity_note: Hypothetical 80% equity/20% debt with full cash receipt, or 100% equity/80% cash and 20% non-earning other assets. No actual instrument split inferred. All receipts modeled at FY26 closing; new debt accrues funding costs from FY27. Regulatory recognition applies to the modeled equity component.

anchor.rwa_proxy_reason: FY25 auditor capital shortfall GHSm1012 and reported CAR -20.19%; infer RWA=1012/(13%+20.19%) only if the same 13% shortfall basis and denominator apply. FY24 auditor shortfall1135 reconciles to 13% ×3177.863−(−722.179)=1135.301 on without-relief basis, supporting but not proving FY25 method. No reported FY25 RWA.
anchor.rwa_risk_pool: FY25 inferred RWA grows with total assets excluding combined cash/bank balances; incremental cash from October capital receives no automatic RWA. Risk mix unverified; 45% and 55% of total assets stress comparisons retained.
anchor.policy_avg_reason: Day-weighted approximate effective-date MPR paths (BoG policy rate trends; 2025 Nov26 date from decision, 2026 Nov18 decision); 2026 rest of year held at11%. Years 2027+ average is midpoint of opening and closing scenario end rates. Compare FY24/25 full-year observed funding cost with same-basis policy average, use fitted slope and floor 1%; no product repricing schedule.

notes: Net-loan credit charge proxy (gross/ECL unavailable FY25); not regulatory NPL forecast. No dividends because accumulated losses and statutory reserve restrictions. No FX P&L due to missing net monetary position. RWA proxy sensitivity only, not compliance.

Statutory reserve allocation uses Act 930 s34 tier proxy (50%,25%,12.5% based on opening reserve relative to modeled paid-up capital); positive annual PAT only, no distribution. Actual bank treatment or regulatory waiver unverified.

Nominal GDP compounded from real GDP and CPI as approximate proxy, not guidance. Investment yield 50/50 full-year 364-day bill and 10-year bond × scenario factor; loan yield annual average policy + scenario spread; cash yield on opening combined cash with no FY26 return assumed on October event. Funding cost fit from FY24/25 actual interest expense/average liabilities; two observations cannot establish causality. No post-event regulatory return; issuer announcement says above minimum at October event, but no actual CAR number. Conditional year-end proxy may differ and must not be represented as current compliance.

Separate estimated net LDR, CAR proxy and NPL path from unavailable reported regulatory/gross metrics. Cash reserve screen applies hypothetical 40% eligible fraction and 80% of that as stress, never treats all cash as eligible.
tax_rationale: Illustrative positive-PBT charge 35% approximates Ghana 25% CIT plus 5% Growth and Sustainability Levy and 5% Financial Sector Recovery Levy; actual tax bases differ. FY25 effective charge 75.955/107.908=70.39%; detailed reconciliation unavailable. No speculative deferred-tax benefit on losses. 45% and FY25 effective-rate stress are hypothetical.
